content: fast-check v4.9.0 (5073 GH stars, actively maintained, TypeScript-native QuickCheck-style property testing) has an official Vitest integration package '@fast-check/vitest' v0.4.1 providing test.prop()/it.prop() extending Vitest's test/it with arbitraries, supports sync/async properties, integrates beforeEach/afterEach per-run. Install: npm i -D fast-check @fast-check/vitest. Ideal fit for subnet/CIDR boundary math (generate random valid CIDRs/IPs, assert invariants like network<=broadcast, host count matches 2^(32-prefix)-2, etc.) and MAC address parsing (generate random byte sequences, assert round-trip normalization).
